sessions.phase_label: CRM data-flow planning and deliverable definition
Tool selection and LinkedIn-to-HubSpot integration design
Campaign, domain, email, and integration setup
Integration verification, lead-sync debugging, and campaign launch

requirements.title: Sales Navigator Lead List
requirements.definition: Configure and use a Sales Navigator list as a source of LinkedIn prospects for the lead-ingestion pipeline.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers source-list selection and maintenance only; exporting, enrichment, and downstream CRM synchronization are independently testable Requirements.

requirements.title: Direct LinkedIn-to-HubSpot Integration
requirements.definition: Maintain a direct integration between LinkedIn or Sales Navigator and HubSpot when the selected LinkedIn plan supports CRM synchronization.
requirements.boundary_note: Remains separate from the Apollo-mediated workflow because the direct integration has its own subscription dependency, failure trajectory, and optionality.

requirements.title: LinkedIn-to-Apollo Lead Export
requirements.definition: Allow selected LinkedIn or Sales Navigator prospects to be exported to Apollo through the browser-extension workflow.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers moving selected prospects into Apollo; duplicate indication, enrichment, and Apollo-to-HubSpot delivery have separate outputs and failure modes.

requirements.title: LinkedIn Duplicate Visibility
requirements.definition: Show while viewing a LinkedIn prospect whether that person has already been saved in the lead system so duplicate exports can be avoided.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently visible duplicate-prevention behavior rather than an attribute of generic lead transfer.

requirements.title: LinkedIn Profile URL Normalization
requirements.definition: Store normal LinkedIn profile URLs in HubSpot instead of Sales Navigator-specific links when lead data is enriched.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a data-accuracy requirement with an independently testable output, separate from whether the contact itself transfers successfully.

requirements.title: Apollo Contact Enrichment
requirements.definition: Enrich exported prospect records in Apollo, including discovering available email addresses before or during transfer to HubSpot.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers enrichment results only; automatic CRM synchronization and fallback handling for contacts that remain without email are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Apollo-to-HubSpot Contact Synchronization
requirements.definition: Automatically send Apollo contact data and enrichment results into HubSpot with acceptable transfer latency.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the Apollo-to-HubSpot delivery path and its latency; LinkedIn export, enrichment quality, and MeetAlfred delivery are independent paths.

requirements.title: Contacts Without Email Ingestion
requirements.definition: Provide a workable process for identifying, exporting, and adding contacts that still lack email addresses to HubSpot.
requirements.boundary_note: This fallback can succeed or fail independently of email enrichment and therefore remains separate from the general enrichment Requirement.

requirements.title: Minimal-Touch Lead Transfer
requirements.definition: Keep the LinkedIn-to-CRM lead flow low in manual effort and avoid unnecessary integrations or repeated manual import and cleanup steps.
requirements.boundary_note: Represents the independently stated workflow-efficiency constraint; functional transfer and enrichment remain owned by their specific pipeline Requirements.

requirements.title: HubSpot CRM Configuration
requirements.definition: Configure HubSpot as the project's CRM on a plan that supports the required CRM behavior and integrations.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the base CRM environment and confirmed plan choice; lead management, reporting, and individual integrations are independently evolving behaviors.

requirements.title: HubSpot Lead Management System
requirements.definition: Provide HubSpot lead-management structures including custom properties, tags, lead stages, categorization, nurturing, lists, notes, and task assignment.
requirements.boundary_note: The listed fields and tools are tightly coupled attributes of one lead-management mechanism; cross-platform status sync and reporting remain separate.

requirements.title: Lead Communication History in HubSpot
requirements.definition: Make lead email and LinkedIn conversation history visible from the corresponding HubSpot record.
requirements.boundary_note: Conversation-history visibility has a distinct data payload and acceptance criterion from lead-stage or engagement-status updates.

requirements.title: Lead Engagement Status Synchronization
requirements.definition: Update HubSpot Lead Status from MeetAlfred or LinkedIn engagement events, including replies and accepted connection requests.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns engagement-event status updates only; communication content and lead-list transfer have separate state and failure trajectories.

requirements.title: Complete Campaign Lead Tracking in CRM
requirements.definition: Ensure leads generated through campaign operations are recorded in the CRM, including leads handled through manual campaign workflows.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the cross-path completeness rule for campaign leads; individual automated ingestion mechanisms remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Contact-Source Funnel Reporting
requirements.definition: Provide HubSpot reporting for a sales funnel organized by Contact Source, including stage counts and contact-to-lead conversion visibility.
requirements.boundary_note: Contact Source grouping, stage counts, and conversion are attributes of one funnel-reporting mechanism; reporting remains separate from lead-stage synchronization.

requirements.title: MeetAlfred Integration Configuration
requirements.definition: Configure MeetAlfred on a plan that supports the required CRM, email, campaign, and Zapier integrations.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the platform and subscription configuration; campaign behavior and each directional data flow are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Zapier Integration Configuration
requirements.definition: Configure the Zapier environment on the required plan, without unnecessary add-ons, to support the project's integration workflows.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the shared Zapier account and plan configuration, not the behavior of individual Zaps such as Apollo-HubSpot or HubSpot-MeetAlfred sync.

requirements.title: Automated LinkedIn Campaign
requirements.definition: Configure and retain automated LinkedIn outbound campaign operation through MeetAlfred unless the client accepts a different campaign mode.
requirements.boundary_note: LinkedIn automation can change independently of email automation, list synchronization, or the number of simultaneously operated accounts.

requirements.title: Automated Email Campaign
requirements.definition: Configure an automated outbound email campaign in MeetAlfred using the campaign mailbox.
requirements.boundary_note: Email campaign execution has independent infrastructure and delivery behavior from LinkedIn campaign automation.

requirements.title: HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred Lead Synchronization
requirements.definition: Push eligible leads from a designated HubSpot list through Zapier into the selected MeetAlfred campaign without manual lead entry.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns lead transfer into an already selected campaign; creating a repeatable campaign-and-Zap pair is a separate operational mechanism.

requirements.title: Repeatable MeetAlfred Campaign Provisioning
requirements.definition: Provide a repeatable procedure for creating a new MeetAlfred campaign and its corresponding HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred Zap configuration.
requirements.boundary_note: Campaign provisioning is independently requested and constrained by platform limitations; it is distinct from whether leads subsequently synchronize.

requirements.title: Silent-Lead Follow-Up Automation
requirements.definition: Move silent leads into follow-up lists and campaigns without repeatedly cleaning or manually rebuilding earlier MeetAlfred campaigns.
requirements.boundary_note: This segmentation and re-engagement workflow can evolve separately from generic HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred lead transfer.

requirements.title: Production Campaign and Lead Safety
requirements.definition: Perform integration work without removing existing MeetAlfred campaigns, using genuine leads as test data, or unintentionally sending obsolete campaign messages.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a concrete operational safety constraint rather than a generic testing Requirement; preservation of campaigns and production leads is the tightly coupled safety mechanism.

requirements.title: Multi-Account Outbound Operation
requirements.definition: Support outbound campaign operation through at least two accounts simultaneously.
requirements.boundary_note: Simultaneous account capacity can be changed independently of campaign automation mode; the specific account identities remain unresolved values.

requirements.title: Campaign Domain Registration
requirements.definition: Select and establish a dedicated domain for outbound campaign infrastructure using a compatible registrar.
requirements.boundary_note: Domain acquisition is distinct from mailbox provisioning, DNS forwarding, and sender-domain warm-up, each of which follows a separate trajectory.

requirements.title: Campaign Mailbox Setup
requirements.definition: Create and configure an email account on the campaign domain using a compatible email provider.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns mailbox creation and provider compatibility; connecting the mailbox to campaign systems and warming its domain are independent behaviors.

requirements.title: Campaign Domain Warm-Up
requirements.definition: Warm the campaign domain and mailbox with the selected warm-up tool before regular outbound email use.
requirements.boundary_note: Warm-up is a bounded executable obligation with its own tooling, duration, and defer/resume trajectory, separate from permanent mailbox configuration.

requirements.title: Campaign Domain Web Forwarding
requirements.definition: Configure the campaign domain to forward web visitors to the client's designated website.
requirements.boundary_note: Web forwarding is independently testable and unrelated to mailbox delivery, campaign integration, or sender warm-up.

requirements.title: Campaign Email System Integration
requirements.definition: Connect the campaign email account to MeetAlfred and HubSpot for campaign and CRM use.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers cross-system mailbox connectivity; mailbox creation, warm-up, and automated campaign behavior remain separate Requirements.

unresolved_candidates.description: Timed multichannel outbound scripts are discussed as a possible separately priced continuation, but the visible history does not clearly establish them as an accepted deliverable.
Paid LinkedIn advertising is proposed conditionally on audience size, but the client has not accepted paid advertising as a Requirement.

The client prefers MeetAlfred automation while the freelancer advocates manual conversations for appointments; later evidence is needed to determine whether campaign mode changes or remains unresolved.
At least two simultaneous campaign accounts are requested, but whether they should be alias accounts, client accounts, or a mixture remains unresolved.
